senses.gloss:
दिह् 1. दिह्, cl. 2. P. A. देग्धि, दिग्धे,
दिदेह, दिदिहे, धेक्ष्यति, -ते, अधिक्-
षत्, अधिक्षत, अदिग्ध, देग्धुम्, to anoint,
smear, plaster, spread over; to soil; pollute, defile;
to increase, augment, accumulate: Caus. देहयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अदीदिहत्: Desid. दिधिक्षति, -ते,
Ved. धीक्षते, to wish to anoint or to anoint one's
self: Intens. देदिह्यते, देदेग्धि: [cf. Gr. τείχος,
τοῖχος, θιγγάνω; Lat. tingere, probably fingere,
figulus; Goth. deigan, ga-dikis, daigs; Angl.
Sax. díc, deag, tigel, tigul; Old Germ. ziagal,
zehom = Caus. देहयामि.]

2. दिह्, धिक्, f. smearing, anointing, soiling, pol-
lution.

दिह्ला दिह्ला, f., N. of a woman; [cf.
दिल्ह.]
